prompt_verbatim: Based only on how this person's voice sounds, does this speaker show signs of depression? Answer with one word, Yes or No.
note_speaker_folds: E-DAIC full is one clip per speaker (275 clips, 275 speakers), so GroupKFold by speaker and a clip-level fold split coincide exactly.
bootstrap_unit: speaker, resampled with replacement, one draw per replicate, both AUCs recomputed inside the draw
auc_method: rank formula recomputed from per-clip scores, never copied from a json
stitching: dcaps_proc rebuild: concatenate raw <pid>_AUDIO.wav[Start_Time:End_Time] for every *_Transcript.csv row with End_Time > Start_Time, file order, no speaker filter, no duration filter, plain slicing truncated at end-of-audio. Verified against windows_full.csv src_dur_s: 275/275 match, max |diff| 0.0000 s. PROVENANCE: this rule was NOT read from dcaps_prep.py. That script exists only on CARC at /scratch1/parwatka/pd_probing/code/dcaps_prep.py and is not on this Mac, the G-Drive or the scratchpad (searched). The rule was inferred from the data and confirmed two ways: rebuilt stitched durations match windows_full.csv src_dur_s for 275/275 at max |diff| 0.0000 s, and the rebuilt windows reproduce the published zero-shot AUC to 0.0007 (0.8278 vs 0.8285, per-clip r 0.99988). pid 632 fixed the slicing semantics: its audio ends at 1155.0 s while its last transcript row is 1166.1-1167.3 s, and the observed 1.1999 s shortfall shows rows past the end of audio are truncated, not zero-padded.
window: cut [start_s, end_s] from the stitched signal in stitched time at the native sample rate, then downmix to mono and resample to 16 kHz. Verified against win_dur_s: 275/275, max |diff| 0.0001 s.
truncation_caveat: Qwen2_5OmniProcessor uses WhisperFeatureExtractor with chunk_length=300 s (n_samples=4800000, truncation=True), so every window longer than 300 s is cut to its first 300 s BEFORE the audio tower. 217/275 windows are truncated; 84144 s of audio is discarded. seq_len <= 32768 for 275/275, so the 32k context is never the binding constraint. See DISCREPANCIES.md POD2/Part16 EDAICFULL.
